nodes.long_description:
1.Connect the wires to the solar panel and voltmeter
2.Bring the bulb, sun, and fluorescent light to the solar panel
3.Connect the wires to the ammeter and the bulb 
4. Get a light source and make the bulb glow
5. throw the sun onto the solar bus
6. move the bus with the controller charged by the solar charger
